quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Proposal
quest.description: Near Aaru Village, you encounter an anxious-looking researcher...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: That fool... running headfirst into the desert like that! Do something, Fodil, please! Give him a hand!

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Apologies. The garrison in the village is limited, and since we're tied up with keeping them from causing any trouble, we can't afford to spare any strength for now.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: But that fool has been bending over backwards to deal with them! At least, in the name of mutual interest...

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Well, it's not that we don't want to help. But the guards are now spread thinly across the desert on the lookout for them. Getting a team together is going to take time...

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: How could this be... If we return to Caravan Ribat for help, it will most certainly be too late...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Eh? You guys are...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just another adventurer passing by.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And {M#his}{F#her} best friend, Paimon!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Adventurers? Really!? Thank the heavens! There's help for Vinayak, at last!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Adventurer! Please save Vinayak. We'll make sure to reward you handsomely!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: First, tell me what's going on.

response.speaker: Fodil
response.text: Well, the desert has become more dangerous than before, thanks to those wretched vermin running amok. It's for the best that I fill you in on the situation before making plans.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Eh... you guys are right. Sorry, I was a little anxious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's been hearing you talk about a certain "them" this whole time. What are they anyway?

response.speaker: Fodil
response.text: A swarm of Wenut. For some reason, they have recently become unusually violent, hiding in sandstorms to attack unsuspecting prey passing by.

response.speaker: Fodil
response.text: When you put it that way, yes. But this time, there are far too many of them.

response.speaker: Fodil
response.text: It's hard to deal with them under the cover of a sandstorm, and they usually flee at the first sign of danger...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's quite the pickle you're in...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: It's not just Aaru Village. Other passing merchants have also been affected. That's why the Akademiya sent Vinayak and me to deal with these unruly Wenut.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: But the caravan we entrusted to deliver some components was attacked by Wenut on the way, and everything got swept up in sandstorms... I fear they've become the monsters' playthings by now...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: I wanted to return to Caravan Ribat for help, but Vinayak... Who knew that after all these years, he's still as rigid as a machine!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: He said something about getting his precious components back and just ran into the desert all by himself!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Ahh!! Maybe I should just let the monsters take him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whoa... what should we do, {NICKNAME}? If we leave this matter alone, not only will that researcher be in danger, but the Wenut problem won't be resolved...

choices.text: This crisis in the desert can't be ignored.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Thank you! Thank you so much! I'm sorry that I let my temper get the better of me... I'll mark the location of the attack on the map. Please find him as soon as possible!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: I hope he doesn't get the hare-brained idea to dive right into the horde of monsters and start picking up components...

choices.text: I've dealt with way bigger enemies.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Getting in from this angle, and using the terrain for cover... As long as the angle of sunlight isn't higher than... And my speed is no lower than... Hmm, that still isn't it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you trying to figure out?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: A viable route to recover the components without having to face the monsters... Thanks to the Wenut, all my precious components got swept up by those monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Whoa! Who are you? When did you show up!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've been listening to you talk to yourself for a while now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Relax. We're not bad guys. Your friend sent us!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Friend? Could it be Shriya? No, she clearly said she wouldn't care if I was taken by the monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Ah, I see. She sent you to get the components, right?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter if I'm taken by the monsters, but it will definitely matter if the components aren't recovered... Yeah, that sounds like something she would say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...You could put it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Still, thanks all the same. I'm racking my brain trying to figure this out. I was this close to rushing out and just taking it one step at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...One wrong step, and I'll get caught by the monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Eh... If I wasn't here, and with Shriya being such a klutz... who else would be going to take care of these machines!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No wonder Shriya was so worried... This guy thinks about nothing but his mechanical components...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's go and get the components before he gets himself in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: I hope he doesn't get the hare-brained idea to dive right into the horde of monsters and start picking up components...

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: These Wenut have become very violent recently, so be extra careful.
